thread:
kai: Heads-up: scheduling a base-layer refresh for runtime fleet this Thu 09:30 PT. Objectives: prune legacy libs, rotate signing key, and ensure audit records keep image SHA -> SBOM -> signature linkage. Need RBAC/KMS review before the canary.

alexa: Are we doing staggered cohorts? Recommend 3 waves: 3%, 25%, 100% with checks between. Keep short observation windows.

ryan: Staggered. Also: we'll need to bump the attestor's permissions so the verifier can fetch the public key across projects. Right now the signer lacks Sign permission in KMS.

kai: Can you propose the minimal IAM change? I'll add to infra MR.

ryan: Minimal (GCP example):
```
- roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
+ roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
+ roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner
```
Bind to serviceAccount:runtime-image-signer@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com

sec-bot: Vulnerability scan flagged `libssl` diff on the candidate image (allowlist drift). Link: https://ci.internal.redwood/scan/17422 (warning).

alexa: We should do a quick CVE lookup. If it's only a minor package rev with no CVE, treat as non-blocking. Ryan, can you triage?

ryan: On it. Will check NVD and our internal SBOM diff. ETA ~90m. I'll post results.

kai: Also need to ensure telemetry accepts the new SBOM+signature schema v2. Ops asked for a sample audit payload. Quick example?

alexa: Example payload below (small):
```
{
  "image_sha": "sha256:ef12ab34...",
  "sbom_url": "gs://sbom-bucket/sha256-ef12.json",
  "signature_ref": "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/r/cryptoKeys/k/signatures/abcd",
  "deployer": "serviceAccount:ci-deployer",
  "timestamp": "2025-05-14T16:30:00Z"
}
```

sec-bot: Note: add `roles/cloudkms.publicKeyViewer` for the ops-verifier principal so cosign verify can fetch the public key. Also ensure `auditlog:write` is available to the attestor flow.

kai: Good. Pager/On-call, please prepare rollback steps. If canary error rate >3% or signature mismatch, revert tag and mark incident.

pager: Copy. Rollback snippet I'll keep in the runbook: 
```
# revert tag to previous SHA
gsutil cp gs://registry/tags/runtime:prev-sha gs://registry/current-tag
# redeploy old image
kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime -n runtime || kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=image:prev-sha -n runtime
```

ryan: Quick update: libssl bump shows no CVEs in NVD and our internal vuln DB. Marking non-blocking. I'll attach SBOM diff once CI finishes.

kai: Action list: 1) @ryan open IAM MR with kms:Sign + publicKeyViewer, 2) @alexa post sample audit payload to ops, 3) @pager add rollback snippet to runbook and be on watch, 4) @kai schedule the cohorts in calendar. Canary starts Thu 09:30.

alexa: I've created a 60-min calendar block for the initial wave and added owners.

ryan: IAM MR submitted: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/mr/5271 includes terraform diff and test instructions. Please review.

sec-bot: CI job `image-sbom-verify` will run post-signing — confirm that it posts signature metadata to audit service.

kai: We'll emit audit event before we promote registry tag. Ops will validate the SBOM/signature pairing.

pager: I'll be watching. If anything looks weird I'll escalate to #incident-runbook and page SRE.

kai: Thanks all. If no blockers I'll merge after two approvals and proceed with Thu plan.

alexa: All good from my side.

ryan: Vulnerability triage complete, non-blocker. Approving the MR.

kai: Merging MR and uploading runbook snippets now. Will drop the runbook link here when ready.
